adapter_provenance.method: Portfolio-level computational judgments apply to the registered numerical tasks; they do not independently validate every historical assertion

reliability.rationale: Numerical contracts, independent aggregate metrics and isolated reference replay pass. Computational evidence does not establish original causal identification or unseen-population performance.

reproducibility.rationale: Every registered task reference runs from portable frozen state; all historical model metric values independently reproduce. Native reconstruction is audited in the separate RAW reports.

mechanism.rationale: Scientific interpretation belongs to the independent scientific-critical portfolio review.

novelty.rationale: No novelty inference is made from computational parity.

significance.rationale: Magnitude and domain value are evaluated by the independent scientific-critical role.

impact.rationale: No deployment intervention or industrial benefit is demonstrated by replay.

limitations: All existing outcomes are exposed for future users.
Prediction-file scoring does not establish training independence.
Some historical state files omit explicit training-group inventories; missing inventories remain unknown.
Trusted replay is explicitly authorized local execution, not a security sandbox.
Alternative discoveries can be scored; references are not unique scientific ground truth.
checks: Registered task independent metric parity and isolated reference replay; see bound computational review.

projection_scope: Original-corpus finding only; inherited independent judgments unchanged.
